name: Humanoid-X
summary: Humanoid-X is Heshi Thinking’s full-size biped humanoid robot. It has a lightweight body, articulated arms, hands and legs, and runs the manufacturer’s Wujie OS embodied control system. The company positions it for commercial service, inspection and household tasks, with perception, task decisions and human collaboration. Published material also describes cooperation with wheeled robot bases and cleaning modules. The robot is an announced platform; broad commercial availability remains unverified.
